''See also: [[Cheska Bennett Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska Bennett is the Head of the [[Navigator’s Guild]] and the captain of the ship known as [[The Eternal]]. A [[Soulbound]] to her vessel, she is a prominent and well-connected figure who often prefers life on the [[water]] to time spent in her office, which is filled with various treasures and memorabilia collected from across the [[Aion Sea]]. Known for her tendency to exaggerate and her cocky, whirlwind personality, she frequently presents herself in rumpled, practical clothing or oversized jackets rather than formal attire. In her professional capacity, she manages guild business and has been involved in high-stakes political maneuvering, including coordinating with the [[Blackwatch]] and managing contracts. During periods of crisis, such as attacks from the [[Optasia]] or encounters with [[Elderspawn]], she has demonstrated leadership by organizing guild forces and preparing shows of strength. Her physical appearance has been noted to change based on her circumstances, ranging from wearing large hats to sporting a bandana and an eyepatch following combat injuries. Despite her unconventional mannerisms, she is recognized as a promising leader within The Empire{{!}}the Empire.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska has [[Izyrian]] red hair that is tied back with a bandana. She wears a wide hat and a blue suit featuring gold trim, and she has one eye covered by a ragged black eyepatch.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As the Head of the Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild, Cheska prioritizes the well-being of her people. She is an opponent of Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius and has shown a dismissive attitude toward the mention of [[Elders]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Cheska is a [[Navigator]] who is [[Soulbound]] to her ship, [[The Eternal]]. In combat or leadership roles, she utilizes a curved saber and a Calder's captain’s horn{{!}}captain's horn.}}
